categories.main_business_segments: Valvoline operates as a single reportable segment focused on automotive preventive maintenance retail services. The company delivers quick, easy, and trusted vehicle maintenance through company-operated, franchised, and Express Care service center locations under the Valvoline Instant Oil Change (VIOC) and Valvoline Great Canadian Oil Change (GCOC) brands. As of September 30, 2025, Valvoline operates and franchises approximately 2,200 service centers and supports over 240 Express Care locations across the U.S. and Canada.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Valvoline's core service delivery is enabled by its proprietary SuperPro system, which standardizes service recommendations and customer experience across all locations. The company leverages digital infrastructure, data analytics, and technology-driven operational processes to ensure efficient, high-quality, and consistent preventive maintenance services. Most products used in service delivery, such as lubricants, are sourced through a long-term supply agreement with Valvoline Global Operations (VGO), ensuring supply chain reliability and scale benefits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Valvoline serves a broad customer base, including individual consumers, commercial fleet operators, and light and medium-duty vehicle owners. Its primary markets are the North American automotive aftermarket, targeting both do-it-for-me (DIFM) consumers and commercial fleet customers seeking convenient, reliable, and fast preventive maintenance services. The company also supports independent operators through its Express Care platform.
categories.geographic_coverage: Valvoline's operations are concentrated in the United States and Canada, with approximately 2,200 service center locations and over 240 Express Care sites. The company has expanded its footprint through organic growth, acquisitions, and franchising, with recent moves to further strengthen its presence in key U.S. regions and Canada. International exposure outside North America is minimal following the sale of its Global Products business.
categories.supply_chain_position: Valvoline operates at the downstream end of the automotive supply chain, directly interfacing with end customers through its retail service centers. It acts as a service provider and retailer, sourcing products from upstream suppliers (primarily VGO) and delivering value-added maintenance services to vehicle owners and fleet operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Valvoline's strategic priorities include maximizing the potential of its core retail services business, accelerating network growth through new store development, acquisitions, and franchising, and innovating to meet evolving customer and vehicle needs. The company is investing in digital tools, data analytics, and technology to enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and service offerings, including expanding non-oil change services and targeting fleet and electric vehicle maintenance opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: Valvoline generates revenue primarily from service sales at company-operated stores, royalties and fees from franchised locations, and product supply and support fees from independent operators. Revenue streams include oil changes, non-oil preventive maintenance services, franchise royalties, and product supply arrangements, with the majority recognized at the point of service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Valvoline competes in a highly fragmented automotive aftermarket services industry against automotive dealerships, independent repair and maintenance shops, and other quick lube operators such as Jiffy Lube, Grease Monkey, Take 5 Oil Change, Express Oil Change, and Mr. Lube (Canada). The company positions itself as a leading, trusted, and convenient preventive maintenance provider, leveraging strong brand recognition, operational consistency, and a scalable franchise model.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2025, Valvoline reported net revenues of $1.71 billion, adjusted EBITDA of $466.8 million, and system-wide store sales of $3.45 billion. The company achieved 6% net revenue growth, 5.5% adjusted EBITDA growth, and added 170 net new stores, marking its 19th consecutive year of system-wide same-store sales growth. Valvoline maintains a robust growth trajectory through organic expansion, acquisitions, and refranchising, with a disciplined capital allocation strategy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Valvoline differentiates itself through its quick, easy, and trusted service model, offering approximately 15-minute, stay-in-your-car oil changes and a broad suite of preventive maintenance services. The company emphasizes high customer satisfaction, operational consistency via proprietary technology, and a strong, recognizable brand. Its scalable franchise and Express Care platforms, combined with digital engagement and data-driven marketing, reinforce its position as a customer-centric, innovative leader in automotive preventive maintenance.
